SAURON Research Console.

A prototype for organizing security assessments and the evidence that supports their findings.

Overview

SAURON explores how model-provider selection, assessment records and report generation can share a single interface. A reviewer can revisit stored evidence and the findings attached to a particular engagement.

Keeping assessment records together

The engagement register keeps a name, profile, status and date on one row. Reports are associated with an engagement so a reviewer can return to the evidence behind a conclusion.

What the portfolio screen shows

The browser interface renders three synthetic completed records from a read-only data source. It demonstrates how a reviewer navigates the registry without connecting to an assessment target.

Capabilities

  • Keep assessment records in a browser-based workspace.
  • Use several model-provider adapters through a common API.
  • Generate reports from the findings and evidence stored for an engagement.

One workflow

  1. Assessment record
  2. Organize evidence
  3. Report findings

Development

The April 2026 prototype combines a FastAPI service, persistence models, a browser client and validation tests.
